in_game_description: The Vossk U'tool is a very powerful device. Rumor has it that each of them is connected to a central Vossk computer that can disable the unit remotely. Because of the uncertainty over the U'tool's security, the device is not as popular as the Terran-built Sight Suppressor series.
mechanics_text: For one energy cell, a ship can turn invisible in two seconds (loading_speed_ms=2000) and remain so for ten seconds (duration_ms=10000).
While invisible, no other pilots can track your ship, stopping all fire towards you.
Enemies are still unable to track you despite being able to see the projectiles and muzzle flashes coming from your ship.
Fast loading speed is ideal for pilots who need quick breaks from intense firefights.
The Scimitar and Specter are pre-installed with the U'tool.
Despite being the least used cloak, the energy cell to cloak duration ratio is the best of all three cloaks.
Cannot be disabled remotely despite the in-game description.
version_notes: CRITICAL: Effect=10000ms is CLOAK DURATION in milliseconds, NOT a multiplier. Previous parser bug would interpret this incorrectly. Loading speed=2000ms is the charging time before cloak activates. GoF2 HD Android has significantly higher price ($97,544 vs $37,717 min). Verification: tech_level=6, duration_ms=10000, loading_speed_ms=2000, energy_per_use=1 — all confirmed.
